description: This file defines a Java record `DbHealthResult` representing the result of a database connectivity health check, including static factory methods for constructing UP or DOWN states.

classes.name: DbHealthResult
classes.description: A record encapsulating the health status of a database connection, indicating whether it is up or down along with additional details.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Creates a `DbHealthResult` indicating the database is operational, with given details.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Creates a `DbHealthResult` indicating the database is not operational, with given details.
